tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild pancytopenia (anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia), and monocytosis with basophilia. There is also mild lymphopenia and neutropenia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. The findings suggest possible chronic hypoxic or hematologic disorder; further clinical correlation and investigation (including bone marrow evaluation and assessment for chronic pulmonary or hematologic disease) are recommended.
